view.title: Ancient Cinder Stone
view.text: A standing stone hums with old script. Reading it makes your teeth ache and your hands steadier. It would also break beautifully.

choices.label: Study it (upgrade a random card, lose 7% max HP)
choices.resultText: The script rearranges something behind your eyes. You are sharper, and less.

choices.label: Smash it (gain 35 cinders)
choices.resultText: The stone comes apart into cinder-light. The hum does not entirely stop.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: Some doors are better left unread.

outcome.resultText: Some doors are better left unread.

view.title: Bloodstained Altar
view.text: An altar of dark stone, its channels worn smooth by use. The instructions are carved plainly: the stone sharpens what is given to it, and it keeps a portion.

choices.label: Offer your blood (upgrade 2 random cards, lose 8% max HP)
choices.resultText: The channels drink. Two of your cards come back keener than any smith could make them.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The altar does not care. It has waited longer than you.

outcome.resultText: The channels drink. Two of your cards come back keener than any smith could make them.

view.title: The Second Cairn
view.text:
Beside the road stands a second cairn. Its swords have fallen into the mud; no names are carved on its stones.

The keeper is not here. The road continues beyond it, and you cannot tell which way the keeper went.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You leave the swords fallen and follow the road. The cairn keeps its silence.

outcome.resultText: You leave the swords fallen and follow the road. The cairn keeps its silence.

view.title: The Caravan Comes Through
view.text:
The Road Warden stands beside Lantern Haven’s mud-spattered wagons. The last one carries the lantern you helped raise.

"You bought these people a road. We can pay our debt. That strongbox is for medicine at the next trading post; it belongs to the cold hamlets."

choices.label: Steal the emergency strongbox (gain 100 cinders and a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: No one stops you. A driver crosses the medicine purchase off Lantern Haven’s manifest. The hamlets’ names remain beneath it, with nothing beside them.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You wave the wagons onward, asking nothing in return.

outcome.resultText: No one stops you. A driver crosses the medicine purchase off Lantern Haven’s manifest. The hamlets’ names remain beneath it, with nothing beside them.

view.title: Warden's Altar
view.text: An altar carved with a face too many-eyed to be a saint. A voice — or something like one — offers to lend you its strength, if you will let it watch through your eyes for the rest of the road.

choices.label: Accept its gaze (gain a random relic; take a Guilt curse)
choices.resultText: The eyes close over yours like a second lid. You do not feel them leave.

choices.label: Shatter the altar (fight what wakes, gain 70 cinders)
choices.resultText: The stone face cracks down the middle. What answers the noise is not stone at all.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The many eyes stay open behind you, patient as ever.

outcome.resultText: The eyes close over yours like a second lid. You do not feel them leave.

The keeper is not here. The road continues beyond it, and you cannot tell which way the keeper went.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: You leave the swords fallen and follow the road. The cairn keeps its silence.

outcome.resultText: You leave the swords fallen and follow the road. The cairn keeps its silence.

view.title: The Keeper of the Nameless
view.text:
A figure in grave-clothes waits at a fork in the road, a lantern of cinder-light held low.

It knows the cairn of broken swords. It knows what you did there. It has been walking since.

choices.label: Return what you took (lose 90 cinders; the keeper stands down)
choices.resultText: The cinders go back into the lantern one by one. The keeper turns without a word and walks the way you came.

choices.label: Stand your ground (fight; keep what you took)
choices.resultText: The keeper turns away, the lantern dimming along the road. The figures following it stop in front of you and draw their weapons.

choices.label: Leave
choices.resultText: The keeper does not follow. It only needed to be seen.

outcome.resultText: The cinders go back into the lantern one by one. The keeper turns without a word and walks the way you came.

view.title: Wayward Pilgrim
view.text: A pilgrim sits at the roadside, robes soaked through, cradling something wrapped in cloth. "Fifty cinders," she says, without looking up. "It was my sister’s. I can’t carry it further."

choices.label: Give 50 cinders (gain a random relic)
choices.resultText: She presses the bundle into your hands and walks into the rain without counting.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.resultText: She nods, as if she expected nothing else.

outcome.resultText: She presses the bundle into your hands and walks into the rain without counting.
